result.stdout:
Description:
  Show details for a device

Syntax:
  device details [<Address>] [options]

Arguments:
  <Address>        

Options:
  -p --param-sets         Comma-separated list of ParamSet keys to show    
                          (e.g. MASTER,VALUES). If omitted, all ParamSets  
                          are shown                                        
  --skip-service-params   Skip the SERVICE ParamSet. It is not loaded from 
                          the CCU and overrides a SERVICE entry in         
                          --param-sets                                     
  -v --verbose            Verbose output
